gen-megrim-instrument-sans: Megrim is all angles and wiry strokes, like a sci-fi poster. Instrument Sans takes over below with sturdy, uniform lines and a small step from capitals to lowercase, so a long page of sans-serif text goes down smoothly.
gen-audiowide-gf-lexend-exa: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide sets its wide-spaced glyphs with tall lowercase beside small capitals. Lexend Exa follows in a sans-serif with big, open curves.
gen-tourney-gf-montserrat-alternates: Montserrat Alternates reads round and chalky, with lowercase crowding the capital line. Tourney does bulky, wide-tracked athletic punch, while the sans-serif handles steady, open text.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-lexend-exa: Mystery Quest brings a bookish, nostalgic feel with open-jawed curves. Its swelling strokes give it old-world character, while Lexend Exa, a sans-serif, runs flat, wide, and uniform in its curves for clear text.
gen-megrim-roboto-slab: Futuristic and angular, Megrim draws wiry letters with a skyward x-height line. Roboto Slab then fills the page with a dense middle zone and open throats, so a long passage reads structured and steady.
gen-righteous-gf-lexend-zetta: Bowls that fill the line give Righteous its fun, commanding look, like thin steel rod bent into letters. Shrink it too far and that bold shape gets lost beside Lexend Zetta.
gen-mystery-quest-bitter: Bitter has a very large lowercase eye and a visible gap in each s. Mystery Quest, bookish and nostalgic up top, hands over to Bitter, whose slab-serif text feels grounded across a long passage.
gen-fs-chubbo-fs-neco: Casual and inviting, Chubbo looks like it was drawn with a marker tip. Neco follows in a serif with a measured swell and open curves, so a long passage feels dignified.
gen-eater-poppins: Poppins keeps its sans curves loose and its lowercase sturdy, with no thin flicker. And Eater, dark and aggressive with wide gaps between letters, looks even sharper against that smoothness.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-inter: Stencil-cut and bold, Snowburst One bridges its tall lowercase with wide gaps, while Inter below has open counters and a smooth tubular line. A long page reads easily.
